name: Curd Cheese & Fig Jam Toast
description: Fast and easy, integral toast with semi-fat curd cheese and fig jam
steps: 1. Toast the bread. 2. Cut the curd cheese and place on the toast. 3. Top with fig jam.

name: Hummus salad
description: With fresh vegetables, easy and healthy
steps: 1. Cut all the vegetables. 2. Add hummus. 3. Mix everything and serve.
